grip.note: the grip's centre is the model origin (the fist box covers y -2..+2); the model is y up with its big faces across z, and the converter turns it by a half turn about x into the weapon frame; the sword is turned flat to the side and tilted 45 degrees forward, as the sprite sword was

note: The Squire's arming sword, tier III (elite): a broad polished fullered blade with a continuous gilt thread in its groove, a 3 x 3.5 px steel boss on the grip with the Order's sun painted on it and a short gilt ray each side, a straight engraved cross with gilt diamond terminals, an enamel-wound grip and a 2.7 px sun pommel in a gilt star; 24.1 px long.
